'''Version 1.10.6''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on May 26th 2026.  It was 109.95 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Fixes and Tweaks</u>====

* Fix for Vectors causing erratic evolution point shifts
* Patched up packet to avoid OOM

* Made no vision overlay slightly transparent
* Made viral and bleeding overlays half transparent through texture file, removed transparency from code.
* Reorganized sound files

* Added block sounds for several blocks: Purifier, lures, flesh blocks, esca bulbs.
* Check against UD1's empty spawnlist

====<u>New Content</u>====

* Changed Eye of Beholder texture and model display orientation
* Made effects have unique particle colors
* Changed several potion effect textures
* Changed loot blocks gui texture
* Updated vomit overlay
* Made lures glow slightly
* Added new particles for when a player interacts with purifier
* Updated textures for four comet and three celestial events

====<u>Mobs</u>====

* Added heavy steps multiple, heavy steps and heavy steps two sounds.
* Updated idle sounds for assimilated enderman and added 2 more idle sounds for assimilated endermen
* Added sounds for assimara enderman
* Added sounds for moving flesh
* Assimilated humans now have a small chance to play old idle sound
* Updated sounds for incomplete forms
